probe.title: AI-Powered Meeting Room Cameras | Huddly
probe.text_sample: AI-Powered Meeting Room Cameras | Huddly Intelligence Solutions Resources Company Blog Partners Contact Sales AI-Powered Meeting Room Cameras C1 AI-driven videobar Crew AI-directed multi-camera C1 Crew New Multi-camera with audio L1 AI conference camera Multi-camera meeting rooms made simple. AI-directed cameras and videobars that scale from one device to five, with plug-and-play deployment, automatic calibration and new capabilities added through software. Certified for Microsoft Teams, Zoom and Google Meet. Find your setup Productive meetings. Smarter workflows. Huddly pioneered AI-directed multi-camera systems where cameras work together to follow the conversation, making sure everyone is seen, heard and part of the meeting. So remote participants can contribute as naturally as the people in the room, teams can stay in the flow together, and work keeps moving during and after each meeting. AI that hears, sees and understands more. Powered by Edge AI, Huddly combines video, audio and spatial intelligence to keep everyone seen, heard and part of the conversation. It adapts the meeting experience in real time, while giving AI tools and agents the room context they need to take part

vibe.evidence: The layout uses a mix of text and images, with a clear hierarchy. The color palette is muted and professional. The typography is clean and sans-serif. The overall feel is polished and corporate, with a touch of magazine-style presentation in the way content is broken up.
